Author: dajoey
Name: Lazy Fish Sitter
Description: Checks every few seconds while you are fishing; if you are not sitting, it runs /sit for you. Leaves you alone once you are seated (ground sit, chair, or pose).
Punchline: Sits you down while you fish. That's it.
Changelog:
v0.1.5.6 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The window was polished for the real in-game font and scale: text no longer clips or sits against card borders.
- The settings window opens larger so the whole page, both cards and the footer fit without being cut off; windows already saved at another size keep it.
- The Sit sends card shows the plain number of sends this trip with no false cap or bar, and turns amber with "Retry limit reached" only when the retry limit is actually hit.
- The invalid-command hint and the Last check line are visible on first open, and Needs setup reads as neutral instead of amber.
- The header, close button with an anchored tooltip, neutral status pill and red Stop button match the other plugin windows; the redundant single-tab row and the rule under the page header are gone.

v0.1.5.5 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The plugin window now has a drawn close button in the top bar that closes the window, and the outer window no longer shows a redundant scrollbar; the inner body still scrolls when fishing details or a smaller window require it. Fishing policy, commands, configuration keys and saved settings are unchanged.

v0.1.5.4 (2026-11-15) [testing]
- The plugin window now presents fishing status, trip details and settings in a responsive card-based layout with a persistent Stop/Enable footer. The native title bar is removed in favour of the drawn top bar. Fishing policy, commands, configuration keys and saved settings are unchanged.

v0.1.5.3 (2026-11-14) [testing]
- The plugin windows have been rebuilt on the shared LalaUiKit: one consistent layout with themed section headers, unified spacing and colour accents. All settings and behaviour are unchanged, and existing configuration loads as-is.

v0.1.5.2 (2026-11-10) [testing]
- Rebuilt against the Dalamud 15.0.4.0 payload for game patch 7.58. No functional changes.

v0.1.5.1 (2026-10-03) [testing]
- **Quick controls for the Lazy Hub window.** The plugin now offers the "Sit while fishing" switch to Lazy Hub (`/lazy`) over Dalamud IPC, so they can be changed from one window next to the other lalalazy plugins. Each change does exactly what the matching setting in the plugin's own window does.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.
- Without Lazy Hub installed the plugin behaves exactly as before.
